data.title: The call beside the empty shelf
data.goal: The call beside the empty shelf
data.situation:
The green fabric shelf was almost empty in July. A string of late deliveries had left Mina with half-finished orders. There was a scarcity of the colour Eli had chosen, and the supplier could not give her a firm date. Mina realised that the shop was overdependent on one workshop. Jay suggested asking a second maker for samples, even though buying a small quantity would cost more. That might offset some of the delays, but not all of them. Mina made a decisive call: she would stop accepting green-bag orders until they had enough fabric. Noor changed the window card while Jay phoned the people already waiting. The empty shelf stayed empty that day. At least the dates on the order cards now reflected what they knew. Mina → customers waiting for green bags
Our supplier has not confirmed the next fabric delivery. We are pausing new orders in this colour. Jay will contact you individually about your current order, including the option to choose another colour or wait for the fabric. We will give a new date when it is confirmed.

There was a scarcity of the colour Eli had chosen, and the supplier could not give her a firm date. Mina realised that the shop was overdependent on one workshop. Jay suggested asking a second maker for samples, even though buying a small quantity would cost more. That might offset some of the delays, but not all of them. Mina made a decisive call: she would stop accepting green-bag orders until they had enough fabric. Noor changed the window card while Jay phoned the people already waiting. The empty shelf stayed empty that day. At least the dates on the order cards now reflected what they knew.
readingBlocks.zh: 七月，绿色织物的货架几乎空了。一连串晚到的货让米娜手里留下许多做到一半的订单。伊莱选的颜色短缺，供应商也无法给出确定日期。米娜意识到小店过度依赖一家作坊。杰伊建议向另一家制造商要样品，尽管少量采购会更贵。这样或许能抵消部分耽搁，却不是全部。米娜果断作出决定：织物备够之前，不再接受绿包订单。努尔改橱窗卡片，杰伊给等待的顾客打电话。那天货架仍空着，但订单卡上的日期至少反映了她们知道的情况。

readingBlocks.zh:
米娜发给等待绿包的顾客
供应商尚未确认下一批织物交货。我们暂停接受这个颜色的新订单。杰伊会分别联系大家讨论现有订单，包括改选其他颜色或等待织物。新日期确认后再通知。

glossary.note: a scarcity of something；不是单个物件暂时没放在架上就说明全市场短缺。
glossary.example: There was a scarcity of green fabric.

glossary.note: a string of + 复数事件；本句不是实物线绳。
glossary.example: A string of late deliveries disrupted the orders.
glossary.exampleZh: 接连晚到的货打乱了订单。

externalEvidence.publisher: Oxford Advanced Learner’s Dictionary / Oxford University Press
externalEvidence.reviewFinding: noun sense 3, string of something series pattern

glossary.zh: 对某人或事物过度依赖
glossary.note: be overdependent on + 对象；本课具体供应风险，不概括所有小店。
glossary.example: The shop was overdependent on one workshop.
glossary.exampleZh: 小店过度依赖一家作坊。

externalEvidence.label: Cambridge Dictionary
externalEvidence.publisher: Cambridge Dictionary / Cambridge University Press & Assessment

glossary.note: offset a disadvantage：抵消某个不利影响；offset 的过去式和过去分词仍为 offset。
glossary.example: A second supplier might offset some delays.
glossary.exampleZh: 另一家供应商可能抵消部分耽搁。

glossary.note: a decisive person/action；本句果断，决定性影响的义另待具体语境。
glossary.example: Mina made a decisive call to pause new orders.
glossary.exampleZh: 米娜果断决定暂停新订单。
